coverage.assessment: Checked vendor blogs/model registries, cloud release pages, independent native-runtime launches, Asian and European technology reporting and comparison baseline. Public social posts and some regional/social indexes are availability gaps.

Checked English and specialist finance reporting, licensed wire origins, company and investor sources, Chinese embodied and industrial financing, French/Latin American regional routes and earlier issue transaction provenance. Private deal timing, full subscription copy and disputed small-round investor names remain limited.

Checked open paper and version indexes, research labs, technical community routes and previously reported proof records. Weekend feeds, publication precision and unavailable paper/community index surfaces limit first-public coverage.

Checked government and standards sources, original newsroom reports, independent security disclosures, supplier and bank changes across several regions. The scope is public reporting; not all policies have publish-time evidence or complete transcripts.

Checked independent author launch communities, registry and GitHub release metadata, regional product reporting, major tool changelogs and third-party access terms. Some registries and original social launch links have access and timing gaps.

discovery.assessment: Open discovery combined exact dated multilingual searches, specialist reporting and funding indexes, author and community routes, event-specific corporate and government publications, and independent reviewer follow-up. Pooled response inventories describe actually returned shared links without attributing them to a single query. The results leave bounded limitations on social post access and paid regional press, with uncertain events kept separate.

article.limitations: Original subscription and social access was restricted for some leads. Weekend indexing, some non-English specialist sources and first-public timing were incomplete. No qualifying unresolved boundary story is counted as confirmed. JEV, Laya, and OSC were not silently mapped to a namesake.

findings.detail: Independent follow-up added Sarvam's manufacturer announcement, WIRED's Wells Fargo contractual reporting, NGA's bipartisan principles, the independent Gall runtime, and contemporaneous Changzhou and NYT/Yonhap reporting. The final article cites the bylined full-text NYT syndication at Business Standard along with Yonhap's earlier in-window account. I independently read the syndicated full text (NYT byline, lines 231–262 and publisher date 18:20 IST). The two outlets share one reporting origin for the claims. The government denial in the syndicated text describes separate earlier allegations and is absent from our summary and body.

The Sarvam source snapshot labels the old model inconsistently across reads. The chart now says 早期版, while retaining the supported vendor-measured 42.6 and 73.9 specifically for the NVFP4 checkpoint on the new side. It does not assert independently measured performance.

Rechecked stale and duplicate events against preceding issue and earliest independently observed links. Together Qwen4 integration, Together's historical prompt incident, OpenRouter's platform response, older Cline and Alibaba model releases, and MIT's first arithmetic result all precede the window. The Atlas notice and two scoped MIT checker completions have separately in-window evidence. No material, evidence-backed boundary-overlap candidate remains for the public watch bucket; unresolved evidence/identity candidates remain in the ledger.

Chinese specialist startup and industrial AI coverage traversed publicly available investor, official, newsroom and local trade routes. Tactile and boxing-robot rounds, local data spaces/base and planned collaboration remain lower priority than the sourced revised HKEX offering and national standards work. Korean resignation/Bessent/Wong follow-ups were evaluated as newer evidence but did not establish corresponding new measures. Earlier policy and technical recirculation was not selected solely by digest date.

Bounded limits remain: NYT direct access, individual FT coverage and some social originals unavailable, some Japanese/regional/industry feeds incompletely indexed, and part of public Sunday paper/slower specialist reporting has uncertain publication precision. JEV, Laya and OSC identities stay unresolved. Public open discovery sufficiently exercised all five topics, English, simplified/traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish and Arabic as well as public independent creator routes, with no category waived.
